names: UK - Sky Sports Main Event HD

rules.merge_requires: matching identity tokens (+1/+2, plus/Sports+, numbers, regions, languages) AND the same name once decoration is removed AND >=50% schedule agreement
rules.never_merged: two differently named channels of the same guide; two different curated identities; names differing by anything other than decoration (those go to owner review)
rules.published: channel ids, display names and timeshift relations only; no programme data
rules.reader_use: a provider tvg-id equal to any member channel_id of a guide may use any other member's guide rows; user manual mapping and provider exact ids still take precedence
